title: createlazy
description: This project adds variant blocks of lower-bound debris in the End, which can provide brand new tools, equipment, and progression. A new dimension has been added, which can be used for construction. It also offers partial mechanical power recipes for sequen
body:
Added a variant of the lower bound debris in the End, which can provide a brand new mineral, along with corresponding armor, tools, weapons, and ranged weapons. These equipment and tools all have unlimited durability. The newly added armor can provide players with buff effects when worn. The new mineral will naturally generate in areas of the End where y > 50.
  Added new End progress.
  Added a new dimension that can be used to build electricity-generating machines and mechanical power production lines, along with the corresponding portals and portal activators.
  Added some sequential assembly recipes for creating items with mechanical power.
  Some items in the mod can be eaten, which will be crucial if you do not intend to add the create mod. However, when eating things that obviously should not be put in your mouth, make sure your surroundings are safe and that you are close enough to the respawn point.
  
  添加了下界残骸在末地的变体，可以提供一种全新的矿物，以及配套的盔甲、工具、武器以及远程武器，这些装备和工具都拥有无限的耐久度。新加入的盔甲可以在穿戴时为玩家提供增益buff。新矿物会在末地y>50的区域自然生成。

![一个创造模式物品栏，包含了该模组添加的全部物品](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/021a9946f9eb349915dc13d60eb9a7c78016d247_0.webp)
![所有的盔甲、装备。可以提供跳跃提升、强壮、水下呼吸、夜视四种效果。](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/87b70975175523c5cfcb936f609df0a0161fc8cd_0.webp)
![生成在末地的新矿物，以及挖掘后的掉落物](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6d008a21294b3527cc56d95097006aac956ee90d.png)

添加了新的末地进度。
![新的末地进度与挑战，完成挑战时请务必注意自身安全](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1d86f198ea10ca47420877992a51ad3e8d3886a3.png)

添加了可以用于建造生电机械和机械动力生产线的新维度，以及相应的传送门和传送门激活器。


添加了部分机械动力创造物品的序列装配配方。
![创造马达的序列组装配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1549aa83c2c70d42e89285baf0a3a5262c527250.png)
![创造烈焰蛋糕的序列组装配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc61179aaaf016cb997e396ad91103074465b855.png)
![由下界合金碎片制取新矿物的缠魂配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/17fdf434a04285a6f173aeceee12167b30bcda4b.png)
![由下界残骸制取新矿石的缠魂配方](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/776d6f6a3ed408e6de74d92f920f40dde0c84327.png)

模组中的部分物品是可以食用的，这在你不打算添加create模组时将至关重要。但在吃一些明显不应该放进嘴里的东西时，请务必保证自己周围环境安全且离重生点足够近
![新矿物加工为可用结晶的关键步骤](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cd26d2f35c4eafa1f125546b6605268d40adcbdc.png)
